exposure: early concomitant treatment with ibuprofen for persistent ductus arteriosus (PDA)
cohort: The study participants were 653 infants born at < 28 weeks' gestational age in a tertiary neonatal centre, some of whom were exposed to early low-dose hydrocortisone and/or ibuprofen.
finding: Early concomitant treatment with early low-dose hydrocortisone (ELH) and ibuprofen is associated with an increased risk of spontaneous intestinal perforation (SIP) in infants born < 28 weeks' gestational age.
